notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the melee wire: SMSG_ATTACKSTART (two full guids), SMSG_ATTACKSTOP (two packed guids + dead u32), SMSG_ATTACKERSTATEUPDATE (hitInfo, packed guids, sub-damage fold), SMSG_AI_REACTION, and CMSG_ATTACKSWING/ATTACKSTOP. MSUI's CombatPackets.cs parses start/stop/swing byte-identically (including the sub-damage absorb/resist summing and trailing zero+spellId+blocked words) and WorldSession sends swing/stop; swing-error opcodes are also mapped to messages.
